standard: shampoo-classification-v1.6.1 candidate (lane-a scrubbed copy); not a locked policy id

formulaBlock.normalization: ID-2: 'WATER/AQUA' one entry; no split entries; 44 normalized entries; normalized positions (names matched case-insensitively)

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine @2, followed by mild anionics Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate @3, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate @4, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate @5. Cocamidopropylamine Oxide @18 is after the E3 point (and buffer-only, C3b). Counter-signal: three mild anionic routes.

conditioningLevel.rationale: high by the Section 5 high anchor's rich-architecture route: W-RICH for conditioning is met by prominent (E3) payload lipids Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil @7 and Persea Gratissima Oil @8 converging with a cationic deposition system (Cinnamidopropyltrimonium Chloride @26, Cocamidopropyl Dimethylamine @30); plus Glycerin @15, Panthenol @17, Sodium PCA @21, keratin/silk amino acids @32-33, Hydrolyzed Keratin @36. C2 is not met (no cationic polymer, no pearlizing/fatty route). Counter-signal: the cationic partners are trace-level and late; without a cationic polymer or silicone, slip may be only moderate; neighbor moderate.

cationic_conditioner: Cocamidopropyl Dimethylamine @30 (amidopropyl dimethylamine, cationic_conditioner per W-LINE item 2)
reset: amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine @2, Cocamidopropylamine Oxide @18 (buffer only)
mild anionic Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate @3, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate @4, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate @5, Sodium Laurate @29 (soap)
excluded: Sodium Polystyrene Sulfonate @14 (anionic opacifying polymer, no cationic charge; excluded by analogy with the 6.4 anionic thickeners)
Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Extract @12 (extract, not the oil)

wLineRecord.note: No a-c candidate before @13; the E3 marker is itself the earliest plausible candidate ((i) surfactants before; (ii) nothing between it and the cap), so the W-line equals the cap and no fallback code is recorded. Both oils (@7, @8) are material. No alphabetical run of seven (Chamomilla @9 to Simmondsia @12 is four).

weightPotential.counterevidence: The cationic partners (@26, @30) are trace-level after salts, chelators and solubilizers; there is no silicone and no cationic polymer; proteins/amino acids are late and low-persistence.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: W-RICH holds for weight: material oils @7-8 (before the W-line @13) converging with present, plausibly persistent cationic conditioners (@26, @30; the W-line is not applied to the partner); reset is limited (C6 low, resetCapacity weak), so the high anchor's rich route holds.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would require reset to offset two prominent plant oils with a cationic partner; a mild sultaine chassis does not. The realistic case for moderate is that the cationic partners are trace and the oils plausibly small, which is why confidence is moderate.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: trace-level cationic partners; unknown oil amounts
weightPotential.rationale: high: W-RICH plus limited reset (6.7 W-RICH, W-LINE, 6.6 high anchor); moderate confidence, neighbor moderate.

careDirection.limitation: formula-only; moisture cluster (oils + humectants) is clearly stronger; repair routes are late and amino-acid level, so the verdict leans moisture_supported

focusPrimary.counterSignal: chamomile/lavender/rosemary extracts @9-11 are scalp-reputation botanicals, not routes
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: claim direction null; moisture-leaning formula; provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: provisional regular; frequent possible with U2 wording (cleansing low); no dandruff active.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: provisional not_targeted (no positioning visible). CSA formula half met by prominent humectant/refatting routes Argan Oil @7 and Avocado Oil @8 (plant oils); Glycerin @15 and Panthenol @17 are after the E3 point, so there is no prominent E4 comfort route (an S-SENSITIVE gate would fail).

dandruffSupport.rationale: not_supported: complete formula without a recognized dandruff active.

amphoteric: Cocamidopropylamine Oxide @18 (C3b buffer only; not prominent)
surfactantClasses.c4: no defining anionic; C6 earliest prominent = Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine @2

uncertainties: W-RICH partner: the cationic conditioners are trace (@26, @30). Under the v1.6.1 partner reading (present and plausibly persistent, wherever listed) W-RICH holds; if a lane judges them not plausibly persistent, weight falls to moderate and conditioning to moderate.
Sodium Polystyrene Sulfonate @14 excluded as an anionic opacifier (not named in 6.4); it carries no cationic charge and does not move the band.
